74.title: Признак наличия интернета у жилья
74.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN has_internet = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS has_internet FROM rooms ORDER BY id;

59.title: Пользователи с белорусским номером (+375)
59.sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone_number LIKE '+375%' ORDER BY id;

61.title: Комнаты, забронированные хотя бы на сутки в 12-ю неделю 2020 (1–7 января = неделя 1)
61.sql: SELECT r.* FROM rooms r WHERE r.id IN (SELECT res.room_id FROM reservations res WHERE res.start_date < TIMESTAMP '2020-03-25 00:00:00' AND res.end_date > TIMESTAMP '2020-03-18 00:00:00') ORDER BY r.id;

62.title: Домены второго уровня почты по убыванию популярности
62.sql: SELECT substring(u.email FROM '[^@]+$') AS domain, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users u GROUP BY domain ORDER BY count DESC, domain ASC;

64.title: Количество бронирований по месяцам годам
64.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::int AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date)::int AS month, COUNT(*)::int AS amount FROM reservations GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

65.title: Средний рейтинг комнат (floor) среди тех, что сдавались
65.sql: SELECT r.room_id, FLOOR(AVG(rev.rating))::int AS rating FROM reservations r JOIN reviews rev ON rev.reservation_id = r.id GROUP BY r.room_id ORDER BY r.room_id;

66.title: Комнаты со всеми удобствами: дни и сумма аренды
66.sql: SELECT rm.home_type, rm.address, COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (res.end_date - res.start_date)) / 86400), 0)::int AS days, COALESCE(SUM(res.total), 0)::int AS total_fee FROM rooms rm LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.room_id = rm.id WHERE rm.has_tv = 1 AND rm.has_internet = 1 AND rm.has_kitchen = 1 AND rm.has_air_con = 1 GROUP BY rm.id, rm.home_type, rm.address ORDER BY rm.id;

68.title: Последний арендатор каждой комнаты и дата выезда
68.sql: SELECT last.room_id, u.name, last.end_date FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (room_id) room_id, user_id, end_date FROM reservations ORDER BY room_id, end_date DESC, id DESC) last JOIN users u ON u.id = last.user_id ORDER BY last.room_id;

69.title: Заработок владельцев комнат
69.sql: SELECT rm.owner_id, COALESCE(SUM(res.total), 0)::int AS total_earn FROM rooms rm JOIN reservations res ON res.room_id = rm.id GROUP BY rm.owner_id ORDER BY rm.owner_id;

70.title: Категории жилья по цене
70.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN price <= 100 THEN 'economy' WHEN price >= 200 THEN 'premium' ELSE 'comfort' END AS category, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM rooms GROUP BY category ORDER BY count DESC, category;

71.title: Процент активных пользователей (арендовали или сдавали)
71.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users), 2) AS percent FROM users u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT user_id FROM reservations) OR u.id IN (SELECT owner_id FROM rooms);

72.title: Средняя цена суток по комнатам (ceil)
72.sql: SELECT room_id, CEIL(AVG(price))::int AS avg_price FROM reservations GROUP BY room_id ORDER BY room_id;

73.title: Комнаты, арендованные нечётное число раз
73.sql: SELECT room_id, COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM reservations GROUP BY room_id HAVING COUNT(*) % 2 = 1 ORDER BY room_id;

76.title: Пользователи и признаки owner/tenant
76.sql: SELECT u.name, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rooms rm WHERE rm.owner_id = u.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_owner, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations res WHERE res.user_id = u.id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_tenant FROM users u ORDER BY u.id;

78.title: Пользователи с hotmail.com
78.sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%@hotmail.com' ORDER BY id;

79.title: id, home_type, price со скидкой 10% при наличии ТВ и интернета
79.sql: SELECT id, home_type, CASE WHEN has_tv = 1 AND has_internet = 1 THEN price * 0.9 ELSE price END AS price FROM rooms ORDER BY id;

80.title: Представление Verified_Users
80.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "verified_users" AS SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email_verified_at IS NOT NULL; SELECT id, name, email FROM "verified_users" ORDER BY id;

58.title: Добавить отзыв с рейтингом 5
58.sql: INSERT INTO reviews (id, reservation_id, rating) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM reviews), r.id, 5 FROM rooms rm JOIN reservations r ON r.room_id = rm.id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE rm.address = '11218, Friel Place, New York' AND u.name = 'George Clooney' ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 1 RETURNING *;

93.title: Alfabank: средний возраст покупателей Smartwatch в 2024
93.sql: SELECT AVG(c.age)::numeric(10,1) AS average_age FROM purchases p JOIN products pr ON pr.product_key = p.product_key JOIN customers c ON c.customer_key = p.customer_key WHERE pr.name = 'Smartwatch' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.date) = 2024;

94.title: Alfabank: купившие Laptop и Monitor в марте 2024
94.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN purchases p ON p.customer_key = c.customer_key JOIN products pr ON pr.product_key = p.product_key WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.date) = 2024 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.date) = 3 AND pr.name IN ('Laptop', 'Monitor') GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pr.name) = 2 ORDER BY c.name;

97.title: Samokat: работающие склады по городам (>80)
97.sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*)::int AS warehouse_count FROM warehouses WHERE date_open <= CURRENT_DATE AND (date_close IS NULL OR date_close > CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 80 ORDER BY city;

99.title: VK: доход с женской аудитории
99.sql: SELECT SUM(items * price)::int AS income_from_female FROM purchases WHERE user_gender IN ('female', 'f');

101.title: VK: первый по времени товар каждого пользователя
101.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, item FROM transactions ORDER BY user_id, transaction_ts, transaction_id;

103.title: Сбер: сотрудники с зарплатой выше руководителя
103.sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN employees chief ON chief.id = e.chief_id WHERE e.salary > chief.salary ORDER BY e.name;

109.title: ДомКлик: страна города Salzburg
109.sql: SELECT co.name AS country_name FROM cities c JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.regionid JOIN countries co ON co.id = r.countryid::int WHERE c.name = 'Salzburg';

111.title: ДомКлик: население регионов
111.sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, SUM(c.population)::int AS total_population FROM regions r JOIN cities c ON c.regionid = r.id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY total_population DESC, r.name;
